title: On Fairness of Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Models
benchmark_measurement: Hatespeech detection across different religious subgroups, evaluating fairness metrics like accuracy parity, demographic parity difference (DPD), and equalized odds difference (EOD).
findings: When evaluating hatespeech detection for different religious groups, the study found no consistent pattern indicating that LoRA worsens subgroup fairness compared to full fine-tuning. In many cases, LoRA had equivalent or even improved fairness. The tendency for which method was fairer could also change depending on the base model used (e.g., Llama-2 7B vs. Mistral 7B).
references: Josh Achiam, Steven Adler, Sandhini Agarwal, Lama Ahmad, Ilge Akkaya, Florencia Leoni Aleman, Diogo Almeida, Janko Altenschmidt, Sam Altman, Shyamal Anadkat, et al. Gpt-4 technical report. arXiv preprint arXiv:2303.08774, 2023.
